Saudi Engineering Scholarships 2026/27: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical & More

November 3, 2026•Scholarship Guides•16 min read

Saudi Engineering Scholarships 2026/27: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum & More

Yes. International students can study engineering in Saudi Arabia through fully funded and other scholarship routes at Bachelor's, Master's and PhD level. Verified options include Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Aerospace, Industrial, Materials, Environmental, Architectural and other engineering disciplines.

The strongest currently verified routes include KFUPM, King Saud University, King Abdulaziz University and KAUST, but the funding model differs: some are fully funded scholarships, some are university scholarship routes, and some programs may only be tuition-free or partially funded.

The most important rule is:

Engineering program exists ≠ international scholarship exists ≠ fully funded ≠ currently open.

Always verify all four.

Are Engineering Scholarships Available in Saudi Arabia?

Yes. Saudi universities officially provide international scholarship routes that include engineering programs.

The available engineering fields vary by institution, but verified programs include:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Petroleum Engineering
  • Industrial Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Aeronautical Engineering
  • Materials Science and Engineering
  • Architectural Engineering
  • Biomedical Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Nuclear Engineering
  • Mining Engineering
  • Environmental Engineering
  • Energy Engineering
  • Earth Science and Engineering
  • Construction Engineering
  • Engineering Management

Not every program is funded in the same way.

1. KFUPM Engineering Scholarships

Direct Answer

King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM) is one of the strongest verified engineering scholarship options in Saudi Arabia. Its official website states that international undergraduate students living outside Saudi Arabia receive a full scholarship, while graduate scholarships are available for all PhD programs and selected MS programs.

This makes KFUPM important for both:

  • Bachelor's engineering applicants,
  • and postgraduate engineering applicants.

Does KFUPM Offer a Full Scholarship for International Bachelor's Students?

Yes.

KFUPM's official tuition and scholarship page currently states:

International undergraduate students living outside Saudi Arabia have their tuition waived and receive a full scholarship.

The university lists possible undergraduate scholarship benefits including:

  • free on-campus housing,
  • course textbooks,
  • monthly stipend,
  • medical services.

This is unusually clear compared with many generic scholarship listings online.

Which Engineering Degrees Does KFUPM Offer?

KFUPM currently offers a broad engineering portfolio.

Verified undergraduate programs include:

  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Architectural Engineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Civil Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Environmental Science and Engineering
  • Industrial and Systems Engineering
  • Materials Science and Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Mining Science and Engineering
  • Petroleum Engineering
  • Semiconductor Design and Engineering

The university also offers engineering-related areas such as:

  • Smart and Sustainable Cities
  • Bioengineering
  • Control and Instrumentation
  • Applied Engineering pathways.

KFUPM Civil Engineering

KFUPM offers a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering.

The university's College of Design and Built Environment also offers graduate-level Civil Engineering programs.

Students interested in:

  • structures,
  • transportation,
  • construction,
  • infrastructure,
  • water,
  • geotechnical engineering

should investigate the exact program and current admission route.

KFUPM Mechanical Engineering

Mechanical Engineering is available at undergraduate and graduate level at KFUPM.

The current undergraduate department page lists:

  • BSc Mechanical Engineering — Internship option
  • BSc Mechanical Engineering — Summer Training option.

At graduate level, Mechanical Engineering is also available under KFUPM's MS and PhD structure.

KFUPM Chemical Engineering

KFUPM offers both undergraduate and advanced graduate study in Chemical Engineering.

Its current Chemical Engineering department describes undergraduate programs built around:

  • thermodynamics,
  • transport phenomena,
  • reaction engineering,
  • process design,
  • laboratory work,
  • industrial training.

Chemical Engineering is also among KFUPM's established graduate fields.

KFUPM Petroleum Engineering

Petroleum Engineering remains one of KFUPM's core engineering disciplines.

The current undergraduate degree list includes:

Bachelor of Science in Petroleum Engineering

while graduate study is also available in Petroleum Engineering.

KFUPM Aerospace Engineering

KFUPM currently offers:

Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering

with internship and summer-training pathways.

Aerospace Engineering is also listed among its graduate MS programs.

major

How Can an International Student Apply to KFUPM Bachelor's?

Direct Answer

International undergraduate students can currently use KFUPM's admission tracks, including its SAT track.

For the upcoming SAT route, KFUPM requires a minimum:

SAT 1350

to apply.

The university states that this route is open to both local and international applicants. Qualified candidates must also pass KFUPM's Mathematics assessment, and an interview may be required.

KFUPM 2027 Undergraduate Dates

For the upcoming undergraduate cycle, the official admissions site currently lists:

Primary Admission Track

10 January – 24 January 2027

SAT Track

1 February – 11 February 2027

Olympiad Track

1 May – 1 June 2027

These dates are particularly useful because they are future admissions dates currently published by KFUPM.

KFUPM SAT Requirements for International Students

For the SAT admission route:

  • SAT score of at least 1350
  • high-school qualification in an eligible academic track
  • Mathematics assessment
  • recommendation letter
  • statement of purpose
  • possible interview.

Meeting 1350 does not guarantee admission. The process is competitive.

KFUPM Graduate Engineering Scholarships

Direct Answer

KFUPM offers full scholarships for all PhD programs and selected Master's programs, while other graduate students may study as self-sponsored applicants.

The full scholarship includes benefits such as:

  • stipend,
  • free furnished housing,
  • air tickets for international students,
  • medical and dental care,
  • subsidized meals,
  • tuition-free education,
  • free textbooks,
  • conference funding under conditions,
  • potential research-assistant opportunities.

Are KFUPM Graduate Applications Open Now?

Yes.

As of 3 November 2026, KFUPM's official graduate portal shows:

MS Thesis-Based & PhD

Status: Open
Application period: 1 November – 15 December 2026.

This is one of the most important currently actionable engineering scholarship opportunities in this guide.

KFUPM Master's Scholarship Requirements

For scholarship applicants to thesis-based MS programs in engineering/science, KFUPM currently requires:

  • four-year Bachelor's degree in engineering or science,
  • GPA of at least 3.00 / 4.00 or equivalent,
  • English-language proficiency,
  • two academic recommendations,
  • any additional department requirements.

Accepted English thresholds include:

  • TOEFL iBT 70
  • IELTS 6.0
  • Duolingo 105.

KFUPM PhD Requirements

For standard PhD admission, current minimum requirements include:

  • relevant Master's in engineering or science,
  • GPA of at least 3.00 / 4.00 in both Bachelor's and Master's,
  • TOEFL iBT 80, or
  • IELTS 6.5, or
  • Duolingo 120,
  • academic recommendations.

KFUPM also offers a Direct PhD route from a four-year Bachelor's degree.

Can You Go Directly From Bachelor's to PhD at KFUPM?

Yes.

KFUPM officially offers a Direct PhD route for applicants who hold an appropriate four-year Bachelor's degree.

The university states that international applicants are eligible for this route.

This can be particularly attractive to academically strong engineering graduates.

Do Saudi Engineering Scholarships Require IELTS?

Direct Answer

Some do, and some universities accept other English tests. There is no universal engineering-language rule.

Examples:

KFUPM Master's

  • IELTS 6.0
  • TOEFL iBT 70
  • Duolingo 105

KFUPM PhD / Direct PhD

  • IELTS 6.5
  • TOEFL iBT 80
  • Duolingo 120.

KAU External Graduate Scholarship

General minimum:

  • IELTS 5
  • TOEFL iBT 61 subject to stricter program requirements.

Can MOI Replace IELTS for Engineering?

Do not assume so.

A Medium of Instruction letter is only useful where the exact university/program officially accepts previous English-medium study as a substitute.

KFUPM, for example, currently waives English-test requirements for graduates from certain specified English-speaking countries, not for every applicant who simply provides an MOI certificate.

Therefore:

MOI is not a universal IELTS replacement for Saudi engineering scholarships.

Profile → Field → University → Requirements → Funding → Current Intake

Fully Funded vs Tuition-Free vs Partial Engineering Scholarship

These terms are not interchangeable:

Fully Funded

May include: tuition, stipend, housing, healthcare, travel, other benefits. Examples: KAUST Fellowship, qualifying KFUPM full scholarship, or KAU external scholarship.

Tuition-Free

Means tuition may be waived. It does not automatically prove that the student also receives housing, stipend, or flights.

Partial Scholarship

Only part of the cost is funded. Do not describe 50% tuition support as a fully funded scholarship.

Common Engineering Scholarship Mistakes

Mistake 1: Searching Only "Saudi Engineering Scholarship"

Engineering is too broad. Search the specific field: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Petroleum, Aerospace, Industrial, Environmental, Materials.

Mistake 2: Assuming Every Engineering Degree Is Fully Funded

A program can exist without a scholarship.

Mistake 3: Confusing International Admission With Scholarship

A university may accept international students under full scholarship, self-sponsored, paid program, or partial funding.

Mistake 4: Ignoring Gender Eligibility

KSU's current external engineering scholarship table is a clear example of program-level gender restrictions.

Mistake 5: Assuming IELTS Is Always 5.0

KFUPM currently requires higher scores for graduate programs.

Mistake 6: Applying to an Expired Intake

KAU's September–October 2026 window has already closed.

Mistake 7: Ignoring Independent University Routes

KFUPM and KAUST operate important application routes outside the normal live Study in Saudi program listing.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Saudi Arabia offer engineering scholarships for international students?

Yes. Verified routes exist at universities including KFUPM, King Saud University, King Abdulaziz University and KAUST.

Are there fully funded engineering scholarships in Saudi Arabia?

Yes. KFUPM, KAU and KAUST all have verified fully funded scholarship/fellowship routes for qualifying international students.

Which Saudi university is best for engineering scholarships?

There is no universal best. KFUPM, KAU, KSU and KAUST have different strengths, degree levels and admission structures.

Does KFUPM offer full scholarships for international students?

Yes. Its official page states that international undergraduates residing outside Saudi Arabia receive a full scholarship. Graduate full scholarships are available for all PhDs and selected MS routes.

Is KFUPM graduate admission open now?

Yes. As of 3 November 2026, thesis-based MS and PhD applications are open until 15 December 2026.

Does KFUPM offer Civil Engineering?

Yes, at undergraduate and graduate level.

Does KFUPM offer Mechanical Engineering?

Yes.

Does KFUPM offer Petroleum Engineering?

Yes, including undergraduate and graduate routes.

Does KFUPM offer Aerospace Engineering?

Yes.

What SAT score is required for KFUPM international undergraduate admission?

The current SAT track requires at least 1350 to apply. Admission remains competitive.

Does King Saud University offer engineering scholarships?

Yes. Its current external scholarship table includes Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Surveying and Petroleum & Natural Gas Engineering.

Can female international students get KSU engineering scholarships?

The traditional engineering programs in KSU's current external scholarship table are marked Male. Female applicants should not assume those routes are open to them.

Does King Abdulaziz University offer engineering scholarships?

Yes. KAU operates a fully funded external scholarship route and lists multiple engineering graduate programs for international students.

Is KAU engineering scholarship open now?

The most recent 2026 intake closed on 6 October 2026. Applicants should wait for the next official window.

Does KAU offer Civil Engineering?

Yes, its international graduate list includes Civil Engineering.

Does KAU offer Chemical Engineering?

Yes.

Does KAU offer Aerospace Engineering?

KAU offers graduate Aeronautical / Aviation and Space Engineering-related study.

Is KAUST fully funded?

Yes, eligible KAUST Fellowship recipients receive tuition, stipend, accommodation, health insurance and relocation support.

Does KAUST offer Mechanical Engineering?

Yes, at MS, MS/PhD and PhD level.

Does KAUST offer Chemical Engineering?

Yes.

Does KAUST offer Petroleum Engineering?

KAUST offers Energy Resources and Petroleum Engineering at graduate level.

Does KAUST offer Civil Engineering?

KAUST does not currently list a general degree titled Civil Engineering on its graduate study page. Civil applicants may find related research in areas such as Environmental Science & Engineering or Earth Science & Engineering, depending on their specialization.

Can Civil Engineering graduates apply to KAUST?

Potentially, if their background fits a specific KAUST graduate program. Applicants should evaluate program-level prerequisites rather than assume degree-title equivalence.

Do Saudi engineering scholarships require IELTS?

Requirements vary. KFUPM requires IELTS 6.0 for MS and 6.5 for PhD/Direct PhD, while KAU's general external graduate scholarship threshold currently includes IELTS 5.

Can MOI replace IELTS?

Only if the specific university/program accepts it. Do not assume a general Medium of Instruction letter replaces IELTS at KFUPM, KAU or every Saudi university.

Can Pakistani students apply?

Yes, where they satisfy the program and international admission requirements.

Are Saudi engineering scholarships currently open?

Some are. KFUPM graduate admissions are currently open, KAUST Fall 2027 applications are available, while KAU's September–October 2026 intake is closed.

Final Answer: What Are the Best Verified Saudi Engineering Scholarship Routes?

Saudi Arabia has genuine engineering scholarship opportunities for international students at Bachelor's, Master's and PhD level.

The strongest verified routes currently include:

KFUPM

Full scholarship for international undergraduate students outside Saudi Arabia, plus full graduate scholarships for all PhDs and selected MS programs.

King Saud University

External Bachelor's scholarships in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Surveying and Petroleum/Natural Gas Engineering.

King Abdulaziz University

Fully funded external scholarship route with a broad graduate engineering portfolio including Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Nuclear, Aerospace and other fields.

KAUST

Fully funded research-intensive graduate engineering through the KAUST Fellowship, including Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical & Computer, Materials, Environmental, Earth and Petroleum/Energy Engineering.

The best strategy is not:

"Find any fully funded Saudi engineering scholarship."

It is:

Engineering Field

→ Degree Level → Academic Match → International Eligibility → Funding Type → English Requirement → Gender Eligibility → Current Intake → Application

That process gives students a much more accurate shortlist and prevents them from applying to closed, paid or ineligible programs.
